# Production distribution intent

This repository ships one production application and one production backend.

The initial production distribution phase is intended for controlled friends-and-family validation using real production services and role-based account activation. It is not a separate beta application or a claim of unrestricted commercial public launch.

During this phase:
- Owner activation remains subject to BIN approval.
- Tenant access remains unit/property invitation based.
- Technician and Staff access remains admin-invitation only.
- Broker access remains verified and controlled.
- Cash and Cheque are enabled according to current product policy.
- Stripe and Bank Transfer remain unavailable until separately proven and enabled.
- Public marketing and unrestricted commercial activation remain held until real-world validation and final launch evidence are complete.
